questionnaire.q1: Do you feel well and healthy today?
questionnaire.q2: Have you ever been refused as a blood donor or told not to donate blood for any reasons?
questionnaire.q3: Are you giving blood only because you want to be tested for HIV or the AIDS virus, or Hepatitis Virus?
questionnaire.q4: Are you aware that an HIV/Hepatitis infected person can still transmit the virus despite a negative HIV/Hepatitis test?
questionnaire.q5: Have you within the last 12 HOURS had taken liquor, beer, or any drinks with alcohol?
questionnaire.q6: In the last <bold>3 DAYS</bold>, have you taken aspirin?
questionnaire.q7: In the past <bold>4 WEEKS</bold>, have you taken any medications and/or vaccinations?
questionnaire.q8: In the past <bold>3 MONTHS</bold>, have you donated whole blood, platelets, or plasma?
questionnaire.q9: Been to any places in the Philippines or countries infected with ZIKA Virus?
questionnaire.q10: Had sexual contact with a person who was confirmed to have ZIKA Virus infection?
questionnaire.q11: Had sexual contact with a person who has been to any places in the Philippines or countries infected with ZIKA Virus?
questionnaire.q12: Received blood, blood products, and/or had tissue/organ transplant or graft?
questionnaire.q13: Had surgical operation or dental extraction?
questionnaire.q14: Had a tattoo applied, ear and body piercing, acupuncture, needle stick injury, or accidental contact with blood?
questionnaire.q15: Had sexual contaact with high risk individuals or in exchange for material or monetary gain?
questionnaire.q16: Engaged in unprotected, unsafe, or casual sex?
questionnaire.q17: Had jaundice/hepatitis/personal contact with person who had hepatitis?
questionnaire.q19: Spent time or have relatives in the United Kingdom or Europe?
questionnaire.q20: Travelled or lived outside of your place of residence or outside the Philippines?
questionnaire.q21: Taken prohibited drugs (orally, by nose, or by injection)?
questionnaire.q23: Had a positive test for the HIV virus, Hepatitis virus, Syphilis, or Malaria?
questionnaire.q24: Had Malaria or Hepatitis in the past?
questionnaire.q25: Had or was treated for genital wart, syphilis, gonorrhea, or other sexually transmitted diseases?
questionnaire.q26: Cancer, blood disease, or bleeding disorder (hemophilia)?
questionnaire.q27: Heart disease/surgery, rheumatic fever or chest pains?
questionnaire.q29: Kidney disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, epilepsy?
questionnaire.q31: Any other chronic medical condition or surgical operations?
questionnaire.q32: Have you recently had rash and/or fever? Was/were this/these also associated with arthralgia or arthritis or conjunctivitis?
questionnaire.q33: Are you currently pregnant or have you ever been pregnant?
questionnaire.q35: <bold>In the past 1 YEAR</bold>, did you have a miscarriage or abortion?
questionnaire.q37: When was your last menstrual period?
